title: Beyond Easy The World
lyrics:
[[Beyond Easy The World]]

[Verse 1]
I never promised stars would stay,
Or every storm would pass away.
Love isn't written in the sky,
It's choosing truth when dreams run dry.
You saw the parts I tried to hide,
The restless thoughts I kept inside.
And still you stood, without demand,
Not asking me to be someone else.
[Pre-Chorus]
.Hari-hari akan terus berlalu,
Mengubah banyak hal dalam hidupku.
Namun yang tumbuh dari kejujuran,
Tak akan runtuh oleh perjalanan waktu. 🎸🖤
[Chorus]
I don't love you like a storybook,
Or a song that ends too soon.
I love you in the ordinary light,
On quiet days and sleepless nights.
When beauty fades and seasons turn,
When certainty is hard to learn,
I'll still be here, and you'll still see
The person you first found in me.
Verse 2
We are not made of grand displays,
Or endless summer-colored days.
We're made of patience, made of trust,
Of holding on when life gets rough.
And every year will write a page,
Not free from doubt, not free from change.
Yet every line will carry proof
That love is more than just a feeling.
[Bridge ]
Bukan tentang kata yang indah,
Atau janji yang mudah diucap.
Cinta adalah tetap berjalan,
Saat dunia tak selalu ramah.
[Final Chorus]
I don't love you like a fairytale,
Or a fire that burns too fast.
I love you as a growing tree,
With deeper roots as years have passed.
And if the road becomes unclear,
You'll never walk this life alone.
Because the truest kind of love
Is choosing every day to stay.
[Outro]
No golden crown, no perfect scene,
Just two hearts learning what love means.
And in the end, that's more than enough. 🎸🖤

title: Don't Let Pass You By
lyrics:
[[DON'T LET TIME PASS YOU BY]]

[Intro]
The world is changing faster every day
Bright screens are lighting up the night
A thousand voices call our names
But we must choose what is right

[Verse 1]
Technology can open every door
Bringing distant worlds a little closer
Information keeps on coming more and more
But not everything we hear is true

Don't believe every word you see
Take a moment, think before you share
Use your mind and speak responsibly
Keep compassion everywhere

[Verse 2]
Our fingers move across the screen
Words can travel in a second
One small message can become so big
It can heal or hurt someone's heart

Use your knowledge to create and grow
Not to bring another person down
Use the digital world with wisdom
Keep your humanity in this changing world

[Bridge]
Being fast doesn't mean we should rush
Being smart doesn't mean we're always right
Behind every machine, there is a human heart
With feelings, dreams, and a life

[Chorus]
Don't let time pass you by
Don't lose your way beneath the changing sky
Technology is only a tool
We are the ones who choose what to do

Think before you speak, think before you share
Choose your words and show that you care
Move ahead, but never leave behind
The values that keep our hearts alive

[Outro]
Let the world keep changing
Let technology reach the sky
As long as we keep our hearts awake
We'll never lose our way

Tiga jiwa… satu pengabdian
Menggema dalam keabadian
Walau ragamu telah pergi
Semangatmu takkan mati

title: Antara Banyurip dan Bollywood
lyrics:
तेरी आँखों में बस गया मेरा जहाँ,  
खोया हूँ मैं तेरी खामोश मुस्कान में।  
Every fall was a lesson to learn,  
Every scar is a badge I’ve earned.  

हर साँस कहे बस तेरा ही नाम,  
मिल जाऊँ तुझसे फिर हर अरमान में।  
No more waiting for fate to decide,  
I hear the thunder rising inside.  

Aku mau cerita ke kamu sekalian,  
Aku sekarang bertempat di Jogjakarta,  
Tapi aku lahir dan dibesarkan di desa Banyurip alit,  
Buaran Pekalongan…  
I was made for more than fear,  
This is my moment, my time is here.  

This is my life, I won’t run away,  
I’ll stand and fight, I’m here to stay,  
Through every storm, through every fall,  
I’ll rise again, I’ll give my all.  

तेरी आँखों में, मेरा जहाँ…  
Ohhhh — I won’t fade away,  
Ohhhh — This is my day.  

सदियों का है ये रिश्ता हमारा,  
किस्मत ने भी लिखा है नाम तुम्हारा।  
Jika jatuh aku bangkit kembali,  
Langkahku takkan berhenti di sini.  

बिछड़ भी जाएँ अगर ये रास्ते कभी,  
धड़कनों में जिंदा रहेगा प्यार हमारा।  
Aku berdiri walau dunia mengguncang,  
Takkan hilang walau arah menentang.  

Sewaktu aku masih muda hidupku di Pekalongan,  
Aku sangat hobi nonton film India di bioskop:  
Garuda, Merdeka, Remaja, Rahayu, Fajar…  
Every fire, every broken stone,  
Aku tetap berdiri, tetap utuh dan kuat.  

Aa Gale Lag Jawa, Aap Ki Kasam, Kabhie Khabie,  
Khel Khel Mein, Suhana Safar, Sholay…  
Shashi Kapoor, Rajesh Khanna, Rishi Kapoor…  
I was born to chase the impossible,  
Dan takdirku bukan untuk menyerah.  

This is my life, I won’t run away,  
I’ll stand and fight, I’m here to stay,  
Through every storm, through every fall,  
I’ll rise again, I’ll give my all.  

तेरी आँखों में बस गया मेरा जहाँ,  
हर साँस कहे बस तेरा ही नाम…  
Ohhhh — I won’t fade away,  
Ohhhh — This is my day.  

Ohhh — I’m still standing!  
Hey! — I’m still fighting!  
Ohhh — Hear my heartbeat!  
Hey! — I’m still rising!  

Woah oh oh — Stand and rise!  
Woah oh oh — Touch the sky!  

Aku kejar hidup yang ku mimpi,  
I’m alive — louder than before,  
I’m alive — aku takkan berhenti,  
I was born to light the dark  
और धड़कनों में जिंदा रहेगा प्यार हमारा।  

Through the fire, through the rain,  
Teri aankhon mein, I feel no pain,  
No more fear, no more lies,  
Tonight is where my future rises.  

This is my life, I won’t run away,  
Aku berdiri, I’m here to stay,  
Woah oh oh — stand and rise,  
तेरी आँखों से ही मेरी रौशन है लाइफ़.

title: The Grand Chessboard
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the silence of the night, they draw the lines
Invisible borders, hidden signs
Kings and queens behind the scenes
Moving shadows, shaping dreams
[Pre-Chorus]
No one sees the hands that play
Every move, a price to pay
[Chorus]
Dunia ini papan catur, kita semua terikat
Kuasa dan ambisi, membakar yang pekat
Setiap langkah maju, antara damai dan perang
Tanpa kita sadar… siapa lawan yang datang
Dunia ini papan catur, dingin dan kejam
Pion dikorbankan demi garis yang tajam
Siapa yang mengatur dari gelap yang sunyi?
Atau kita sendiri… yang terjebak di sini
[Verse 2]
Oceans whisper, mountains spy
Satellites watch from the sky
Alliances built, then torn apart
Peace is just a fragile art
[Pre-Chorus]
Smiles in rooms with hidden knives
Trading futures, trading lives
[Chorus]
Dunia ini papan catur, kita semua terikat
Kuasa dan ambisi, membakar yang pekat
Setiap langkah maju, antara damai dan perang
Tanpa kita sadar… siapa lawan yang datang
[Bridge – slow, emotional build]
Are we kings or just the pawns?
Dancing till the truth is gone
Who decides what’s right or wrong?
Echoes in a broken song
[Final Chorus – lebih megah]
Dunia ini papan catur, dengar seruannya
Bangkit jadi raja… atau jatuh selamanya
Di balik bayangan dan dusta yang dalam
Hanya yang kuat… yang mampu bertahan
Dunia ini papan catur, api menyala
Siang jadi perang di gelapnya dunia
Namun di balik semua permainan kejam…
Kitalah pemain… dan kita juga bidak dalam diam

title: Shadows of Alliance
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In the fire of the eastern sky
Sirens scream as missiles fly
Lines are drawn in desert sand
Power shifting hand to hand
From the oceans to the flame
Different flags, the same old game
Promises carved into stone
But every king stands not alone
[Pre-Chorus]
Alliances in the dark align
Truth gets lost between the lines
[Chorus – Anthem Indo]
Dunia terbakar oleh janji dan kuasa
Aliansi berdiri… membawa bencana
Langit pun retak oleh dentuman perang
Dan manusia kecil… jadi korban yang hilang
Di balik bendera dan teriakan benar
Ada luka yang tak pernah terdengar
Siapa pahlawan… siapa yang salah?
Atau semua hanya… permainan arah?
[Verse 2]
Iron birds across the night
Cities fading out of sight
Echoes of a thousand cries
Hidden under leaders’ lies
Sanctions, shadows, silent wars
Broken dreams behind closed doors
Every move a calculated cost
Every gain another lost
[Pre-Chorus]
Voices drown in roaring skies
Peace is just a thin disguise
[Chorus – Anthem Indo]
Dunia terbakar oleh janji dan kuasa
Aliansi berdiri… membawa bencana
Langit pun retak oleh dentuman perang
Dan manusia kecil… jadi korban yang hilang
[Bridge – slow, emotional]
Is there justice in the fire?
Or just fuel for more desire?
Are we free… or just a name
In someone else’s endless game?
[Final Chorus – lebih megah]
Dunia ini panggung perang tak berujung
Kebenaran hilang… tertutup mendung
Langkah demi langkah… takdir diputar
Dan sejarah ditulis… oleh yang paling kuat
Namun di balik semua ambisi dan luka
Masih ada harapan yang tak pernah sirna
Walau dunia ini terbagi dan kelam…
Manusia tetap mencari… arti kedamaian

Janji Setia

Janji setia tetap milikku.

Kasam se, dil takkan berpaling,
Meski badai datang menghadang.
Satu hati, satu cinta,

Janji setia, takkan berubah,
Bagai bintang menjaga malam.
Hatiku milikmu selamanya,
Tak lekang oleh waktu dan alam.

Angin membawa doa cinta.

title: Ashes in the Snow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Cold rain falling on the broken street
Your shadow dancing under dying lights
I still hear your whisper in the dark
Like a ghost that never leaves my mind

[Pre-Chorus]
Every wound becomes a star tonight
Burning slowly in the endless sky

[Chorus]
I scream your name into the blackened night
Through the fire, through the endless white
Even if the world fades into gray
My heart will chase your soul away

[Verse 2]
Frozen roses underneath our feet
Memories turning into ash and smoke
Your eyes were heaven in a dying world
Now silence cuts deeper than before

[Bridge]
Falling...
Into the void again
But your light remains
Inside my veins

[Final Chorus]
I scream your name into the storm tonight
Broken angels crying in the light
Even if my soul begins to fade
Your love will haunt me through the rain

[Outro]
Ashes in the snow...
Never letting go...

title: Siti Nurbaya
lyrics:
Judul: Siti Nurbaya

Di Ranah Minang…
adat dijunjung, pusako dipertahankan.

pernah tumbuh cinta
yang akhirnya patah oleh keadaan.

[Verse 1]
Di ranah tempat rindu bermula
Samsul datang membawa cahaya
Di bawah sinar bulan purnama
Siti Nurbaya jatuh percaya

Angin dari lurah dan sawah
Membawa kaba tentang cinta
Dua hati dipayung asmara
Berjanji sehidup semati bersama

[Pre-Chorus]
Namun adat mulai bicara
Mamangan datang membawa luka
Harta dan nama lebih utama
Daripada hati yang saling cinta

[Chorus]
Siti Nurbaya manangih malam itu
Saat Samsul Bahri manahan pilu
Bukan hati nan ingin lalu
Namun dunia indak merestu

Janji suci kini jadi abu
Cinto mereka tetap basuo
Meski takdir memisahkan itu

Talempong menangih di kejauhan
Mengiring sunyi dalam hati
Langkah Samsul makin menjauh
Namun cintanya tak pernah mati

Di balik jendela rumah gadang
Namanya tetap dipanggil angin
Meski harapan mulai hilang

Wahai angin Ranah Minang

Meski waktu terus berjalan
Talempong tetap dendangkan kenangan
Tentang cinta di Ranah Minang
Yang abadi dalam kehilangan.

title: Sendiri Bukan Berarti Sepi

I walk this road with quiet fire in my soul

I learned to dance inside the rain

Harapanku tetap setinggi langit biru
Aku utuh, aku cukup, aku berarti

Ketemu dikit jantung langsung goyang.
Aye mah bukan abang-abang tajir,
Tapi modal sayang kagak pernah luntur.

Sabtu Minggu aye nongkrong di gang,
Nungguin neng lewat sambil buang pandang.

Neng... jangan bikin abang penasaran,
Chat dibales cuma pake emot senyuman.
Kalo emang hati udah sejalan,
Yuk kita ngomongin pelaminan.

Neng... kapan kita kawin?
Jangan sampe ubanan baru yakin.
Aye udah siap jadi imam lahirin batin,
Asal jangan bilang... "Abang,nunggu negara kite makmur baru kawin..."

title: Under The One Sky
lyrics:

n a world… divided by fear…
Where lines were drawn… not by nature… but by men…
We forgot…
That we were never meant to be enemies…
We were meant… to stand…
Under one sky…

We were born with different stories
Different names our mothers gave
But every heart is always searching
For a gentle place to stay
....Presented by LINA COLLECTION

We draw lines on dusty borders
Say you’re wrong and I am right
But tears don’t care about the color
They all fall the same at night

If you listen to the silence
You will hear the same old prayer…
🎵 [Chorus] 
Let’s hold hands and drop the fear
There’s no enemy here
We are standing under one sky
Trying just to survive
Not your race, not your belief
That will set us free
It’s the love in our humanity
🎵 [Verse 3]
Children laughing in the distance
They don’t ask what God you know
They just need a little light
To guide them as they grow
🎵 [Pre-Chorus]
If we stop for just a moment
We’ll remember how to care…
🎵 [Chorus – Repeat]

Di dunia ini kita bersaudara

Let’s hold hands and drop the fear
There’s no enemy here
We are standing under one sky
No more you… no more I…
Not your race, not your belief
That will set us free
It’s the love… in our humanity
🎵 [Outro]
Under one sky…
We are finally learning…
to be free…

title: Cinta Musim Durian
lyrics:
Eh kamu tahu nggak…
Katanya cinta itu musiman…

Awal ketemu kamu biasa saja
Nggak ada tanda-tanda jatuh cinta
Tapi makin lama kok beda rasanya
Kayak bau durian… nyengat ke mana-mana

Teman-temanku mulai curiga
Katanya aku berubah gaya
Senyum-senyum sendiri tiap hari
Kayak habis makan durian satu peti

Cintaku tak kenal musim sayang
Kayak durian datang menyerang
Kadang manis kadang bikin pening
Tapi tanpamu aku jadi pusing 
Cintaku nggak bisa berhenti
Walau kadang bikin mual di hati
Orang lain mungkin nggak tahan
Tapi aku… ketagihan kamu, sayang 

Katanya cinta harus logika
Tapi aku malah makin gila
Walau kamu kadang ngeselin
Tetap aja pengin aku pelukin

Kalau kamu itu durian
Aku rela antri berjam-jam
Walau baunya bikin ribut
Tetap aja kamu yang kuikut 

Cintaku tak kenal musim sayang
Nggak peduli hujan atau terang
Kayak durian selalu kutunggu
Jatuh cinta… tiap ketemu kamu
